title: Gd3+ engineered Co–Mn–Mg spinel nanoferrites for multifunctional theranostics: magnetic hyperthermia, antioxidant hepatoprotection, and antibacterial activity
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,48405-48426
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08039H, Paper

M. Elansary, N. Bentarhlia, O. Oulhakem, Y. Mouhib, B. Salameh, A. M. Alsmadi, B. Kartah, H. Monfalouti, M. Belaiche, O. M. Lemine
We synthesized Co0.5Mn0.25Mg0.25Fe2−xGdxO4 (x = 0.00; 0.04; 0.06) nanoferrites using a sol–gel auto-combustion method and studied their structural, magnetic, and biological properties.
